Rotating Gateway Tunnel

Configure client tools (curl, yt-dlp, browser) to use Looker's zero-install local forwarder. Upstream proxies rotate transparently with pre-commit retries.

http://127.0.0.1:8080

looker-down Helper

Paste any MEGA file or public folder URL to generate high-speed chunked download command:

looker-down <URL> --workers 16
